comparison.objective: Remove a worn toothbrush head and install a new one, with some versions also opening its clamshell pack.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, axial press-fit extraction/insertion, disposal, and optional package opening versus socket engagement and collar tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the new head fully seated, worn head binned, and arms returned; no impact testing or setting retention. Rubric is complete across versions.
comparison.reason: Axial press-fit replacement is materially different from adjusting and validating a damper.
